entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF789-011. The shoes just aren't working out for me.
Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Vent cycling shoes. Before we proceed, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit issue. I've taken them on a few rides, tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels. They're just not the right shape for my foot.

I'm sorry to hear that; getting blisters is definitely no fun. Let me check the delivery date to see what our options are... It looks like they were delivered 42 days ago. That's well within our 90-day return policy.
Oh, great. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the 90-day period, you're eligible for a full refund to your original payment method. I've just initiated the return process for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email on file.

Excellent, I appreciate that. Now, since I did have to go through the trouble of testing them and dealing with the blisters, and now have to package them up and call in, would it be possible to add a small discount code to my account for a future purchase? Maybe 15% off my next pair of cycling shoes?

I understand your position, but our policy for a standard return is to provide the full refund for the item, which I've already processed for you. We aren't able to add promotional credits on top of the refund, but I'm confident we can help you find a different pair of shoes that will be a much better fit.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is fair. I'll look for that email with the label. Thanks for your help, Alex.

You're very welcome, Sam. The email should arrive within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
